description: Shadow base-batcher and parity (shadow) validator health for the local devnet. Mirrors the Datadog "Shadow Batcher" dashboard, adapted to the metrics exported on job="batcher".

panels.description: Latched flag: a parity-validator re-derived L2 from what the shadow batcher published to L1 and its block hashes diverged from the sequencer. Any non-zero value is a hard failure.
panels.title: Ever diverged

panels.description: Whether the batcher's L2 block parity monitor is enabled.
panels.title: Parity checking

panels.description: Total L2 blocks compared between the sequencer and the parity validator.
panels.title: Blocks checked

panels.description: L2 blocks whose derived hash matched the sequencer.
panels.title: Matches

panels.description: L2 blocks whose derived hash did NOT match the sequencer. Non-zero is a failure.
panels.title: Mismatches

panels.description: Blocks the parity validator expected but could not fetch. Non-zero is a failure.
panels.title: Missing blocks

panels.description: Rate of parity check results. A healthy shadow shows only matches.
panels.title: Parity check outcomes (per second)

panels.description: Count of failed parity checks per interval, by failure type.
panels.title: Failed checks, by type

panels.description: Errors the parity monitor hit while fetching data to compare, grouped by scope (block vs pass).
panels.title: Parity monitor errors, by scope

panels.description: L1 batch submission attempts by outcome (submitted / confirmed / requeued / failed). Requeued and failed indicate trouble getting batches on-chain.
panels.title: Submission outcomes, per interval

panels.description: Batcher backpressure: L1 txs awaiting confirmation, frames queued for L1, and L2 blocks buffered in the pipeline.
panels.title: In-flight L1 submissions

panels.description: Batcher pipeline resets per interval, by reason (reorgs, safe-head mismatch, stalled channels, admin pause).
panels.title: Pipeline resets, by reason

panels.description: Channels the batcher had to replay/re-submit per interval.
panels.title: Channel replays

panels.description: Why channels closed per interval (timeout / soft_target / protocol_limit / flush / discard).
panels.title: Channel closes, by cause

panels.description: Rate of channels opened, closed, and fully submitted to L1.
panels.title: Channel lifecycle (per second)

panels.description: Mean number of L1 blocks a channel stayed open (histogram sum/count).
panels.title: Avg channel lifetime (L1 blocks)

panels.description: Mean channel compression ratio (output/input) as a percent.
panels.title: Avg channel compression (%)

panels.description: Mean uncompressed vs compressed bytes per channel.
panels.title: Avg channel size (kB)

panels.description: Mean fraction of each blob that was filled with data.
panels.title: Avg blob fill (%)

panels.description: Mean number of blobs attached to each blob-carrying L1 tx.
panels.title: Avg blobs per blob tx

panels.description: Mean number of L2 blocks packed into each channel.
panels.title: Avg L2 blocks per channel

panels.description: Data-availability bytes submitted to L1 per second, split by calldata vs blob.
panels.title: DA bytes submitted (per second), by type

panels.description: L1 tx-manager publish/RPC errors and fee bumps per interval. Fee bumps mean txs were underpriced and had to be re-sent higher.
panels.title: Tx manager errors and fee bumps

panels.description: Mean time from send to confirmation for L1 batcher txs.
panels.title: Avg send latency, confirmed txs (ms)

panels.description: L1 base fee and the batcher's tip / blob fee caps, in gwei (log scale).
panels.title: L1 base fee and fee caps (gwei)

panels.description: Rate of confirmed vs failed L1 batcher transactions.
panels.title: Confirmed vs failed L1 txs (per second)

panels.description: Current ETH balance of the shadow batcher's L1 signer. A steady decline that is not topped up will eventually stall submissions.
panels.title: Batcher signer balance (ETH)

panels.description: Latest L1 nonce used by the batcher signer.
panels.title: Current L1 nonce

panels.description: Cumulative confirmed L1 batcher transactions.
panels.title: Confirmed L1 txs (total)

panels.description: Cumulative failed L1 batcher transactions. Non-zero warrants a look.
panels.title: Failed L1 txs (total)

title: Shadow Batcher
